text.p: Malaysian Resources Corp Bhd (MRCB) has been granted an extension in its stock suspension until November 21, a statement from the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange (KLSE) said.

In the statement sent out to exchange members on Wednesday, the KLSE said the extension from November 7 was to allow MRCB to announce details of its proposed acquisition of an equity stake in stockbroking firm Rashid Hussain Bhd.

MRCB, a diversified company whose interests include property, broadcasting and publishing, said on October 30 that it had received central bank clearance to enter into talks for the stake, the size of which it did not disclose.
Rashid Hussain has separately also announced it is negotiating to acquire Malayan Banking Bhd's (Maybank) 75 percent stake in Kwong Yik Bank Bhd.
MRCB's stock closed at 9.70 ringgit on October 22, while Rashid Hussain shares finished at 15.80 ringgit on October 18.
